caption: Peak load of 150 req/s reaches the broker, which leaves 100 req/s in the private cloud and sends 50 req/s to the public cloud. Notice that the broker, not the public cloud, makes the split.

spec.title: Burst split
spec.aria: A peak load of 150 requests per second reaches a burst broker, which sends 100 requests per second to a private cloud and 50 to a public cloud.
